module.description: Implement a 64-bit Johnson counter (torsional ring counter), and the state of the similar 4-bit Johnson counter example is as follows: 0000, 1000, 1100, 1110, 1111, 0111, 0011, 0001, 0000.

ports.input: Clock signal used for synchronous operation.
Active-low reset signal to initialize the counter.
ports.output: 64-bit register representing the current count value.

logic_description.description: Notice that below descriptions are along with tags <logic />. With a <logic type="combinational_logic" />, must construct this logic as interal wire declaration. Or this <logic type="combinational_logic" /> can be declared as a `reg` but only be used in always(*) block. With a <logic type="sequential_logic" />, must construct this logic as `reg` declaration. Must update this logic, in an always block, based on other <logic type="sequential_logic" /> or <logic type="combinational_logic" /> states. With a <logic type="sequential_logic_operation" />, no declaration for this keyword. Just place this operation sequence in below mentioned description. With a <logic type="combinational_logic_operation" />, no declaration for this keyword. Just based on the keyword `assign` to construct description of this combinational logic operation.
logic_description.logic: The current <output refid="Q"> is a concatenation of 1-bit 1 and 63 bits [63:1] of <logic refid="Q">.
The current <output refid="Q"> is a concatenation of 1-bit 0 and 63 bits [63:1] of <output refid="Q">.

module.implementation: On every rising edge of the clock signal (clk) or the falling edge of the reset signal (rst_n), the counter value is updated. If the reset signal (rst_n) is low, indicating a reset condition, the counter value (Q) is set to 0. Otherwise, if the least significant bit (Q[0]) is 0, the counter increments by shifting the current value `Q` based on `Q_right_increament_shifting`. If the least significant bit (Q[0]) is 1, the counter decrements by shifting the current value based on `Q_right_decreament_shifting`.
